executive_summary: Recent KEV‑listed vulnerabilities affect common dev‑ops and client‑side components, offering practical lab opportunities for secure coding, patch validation, and detection.

signals.title: GitLab Path Traversal Vulnerability (CVE-2026-85706)
signals.what_changed: Added to CISA KEV list on 2026-09-11
signals.why_it_matters: Unauthenticated users can read arbitrary files via improper path confinement
signals.application: Deploy GitLab CE Docker, craft request with ?path=../etc/passwd to read /etc/passwd, then implement path sanitization

signals.title: JFrog Artifactory Token Scope Validation Bypass (CVE-2026-42016)
signals.what_changed: Added to CISA KEV list on 2026-09-11
signals.why_it_matters: Token scope not validated allows privilege escalation in CI/CD pipelines
signals.application: Run Artifactory Docker, send request with token lacking required scope, demonstrate unauthorized repository access, then fix scope validation

signals.title: mcp-gitlab Unauthenticated File Read Leading to PAT Exfiltration (GHSA-cv3r-c5h8-f4g5)
signals.why_it_matters: Allows unauthenticated read of files, enabling personal access token theft and full account takeover
signals.application: Create Node.js app using @zereight/mcp-gitlab, trigger upload_markdown endpoint, capture PAT, then enforce authentication and input validation

signals.title: Microsoft Windows Update Stack Local Privilege Escalation (CVE-2026-81963)
signals.what_changed: Added to CISA KEV list on 2026-09-08
signals.why_it_matters: Local attacker can escalate to SYSTEM, important for Windows hardening
signals.application: Use Windows VM, verify unpatched state, apply Microsoft security update, then test mitigation via patch management

signals.title: Google Chromium V8 Out‑of‑Bounds Write (CVE-2026-87491)
signals.what_changed: Added to CISA KEV list on 2026-09-09
signals.why_it_matters: Remote attacker can execute arbitrary code via crafted HTML, affecting browsers
signals.application: Run Chromium in Docker, serve malicious HTML page, observe sandbox escape, then implement CSP and proper bounds checking

experiment.title: Lab: Exploit and Mitigate GitLab Path Traversal (CVE-2026-85706)
experiment.objective: Demonstrate unauthenticated file read via path traversal in GitLab CE and implement input sanitization
steps: Pull and run GitLab CE container exposing port 80
Access GitLab endpoint for repository uploads (e.g., /gitlab/api/v4/projects/1/repository/uploads)
Send crafted request with ?path=../etc/passwd using curl
Modify application or proxy to sanitize the path parameter
Re‑send request and verify no file content is returned
expected_evidence: HTTP response with /etc/passwd file content when path traversal is used
No file content when sanitized path is used
Documentation of successful exploit and mitigation
experiment.stop_condition: When successful exploit and mitigation are demonstrated within 45 minutes

discarded: Older KEV items beyond the 5‑day window
backlog: Study Adobe Commerce template injection CVE-2026-75650
